items.prompt: The bank says that Direct Connect is private. Does private mean encrypted?
items.ten_second: No. Direct Connect keeps traffic off the internet, but it does not encrypt it. Add an IPsec VPN over it, or MACsec.
sixty_second: The short answer is: no. Private does not mean encrypted.
It works like this. Direct Connect skips the internet and uses a private line.
But Direct Connect does not encrypt your traffic. You add that yourself.
One way is an IPsec VPN over the line. It encrypts end to end.
The other way is MACsec. It encrypts the link up to the Direct Connect location.
The thing to watch is where each one stops. MACsec covers one link, not the path.
And it runs only on larger dedicated connections, not on hosted ones.
A VPN lowers the MTU, which might reduce throughput.
In your case, I'd run a private IP VPN over the transit virtual interface.
It encrypts the whole path to the transit gateway, with no public IP addresses.
Does the questionnaire ask for encryption on the link, or end to end?
skeleton: private IP VPN to transit gateway

key_points.point: Direct Connect bypasses the internet and uses dedicated, private network connections; the traffic stays on the AWS global network backbone.
accept: it skips the internet
it is a private line to AWS

key_points.point: Direct Connect does not encrypt traffic in transit by default.
accept: private is not encrypted
you add the encryption yourself

key_points.point: An IPsec VPN over Direct Connect gives end-to-end IPsec-encrypted connections, but it reduces the MTU size, which might reduce throughput.
accept: a VPN over the line encrypts end to end
the VPN makes packets smaller

key_points.point: MACsec encrypts from your corporate data center to the Direct Connect location, on 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps dedicated AWS Direct Connect connections.
accept: MACsec encrypts the link to the Direct Connect location
MACsec needs a fast dedicated connection

key_points.point: MACsec provides point-to-point security on Ethernet links, so it does not provide end-to-end encryption across several network segments.
accept: MACsec covers one link only

key_points.point: Private IP VPN deploys IPsec VPN over Direct Connect without public IP addresses, and you need a transit gateway for it.
accept: a VPN over Direct Connect with private addresses
no public IP addresses needed

must_not_say.error: Direct Connect is a private line, so the traffic on it is encrypted.
must_not_say.correct: Direct Connect does not encrypt your traffic in transit by default. Add an IPsec VPN over Direct Connect, or MACsec.

must_not_say.error: MACsec encrypts the traffic all the way to the instance.
must_not_say.correct: MACsec provides point-to-point security on Ethernet links. It does not provide end-to-end encryption across several network segments.

must_not_say.error: With MACsec turned on, we can stop using TLS in the application.
must_not_say.correct: MACsec is not intended as a replacement for other encryption. Continue to use the encryption technologies you already use.

follow_ups.question: Can we use MACsec on a hosted connection?
follow_ups.answer: No. MACsec is not supported on 1 Gbps dedicated connections or on any hosted connections. Use an IPsec VPN over Direct Connect instead.

follow_ups.question: Do we need public IP addresses for a VPN over Direct Connect?
follow_ups.answer: Not with private IP VPN. It lets you deploy IPsec VPN over Direct Connect without public IP addresses. You need a transit gateway for it.

items.prompt: We need to connect our data center to AWS. Should we use a VPN or Direct Connect?
items.persona: a startup founder in office hours
items.ten_second: Start with a Site-to-Site VPN: it is encrypted and ready in minutes. Add Direct Connect for consistent performance, and keep the VPN as backup.
sixty_second: The short answer is: start with a VPN, then add Direct Connect for steady performance.
It works like this. A Site-to-Site VPN uses IPsec over the public internet.
You can configure it in minutes, and it fits low to modest bandwidth.
But internet performance is best effort and can change.
Direct Connect is a private line that skips the internet.
It gives a more consistent network experience than the internet.
The thing to watch is time and cost.
A new dedicated connection can take several weeks to a few months.
And you pay for port hours even when no data passes.
In your case, I'd start the VPN now and order Direct Connect in parallel.
When it arrives, it becomes the main path, and the VPN stays as backup.
How much data do you move each day, and how soon must the link work?
skeleton: Direct Connect: consistent, weeks to months

key_points.point: A VPN uses IPsec over the public internet; it can be configured in minutes and suits low to modest bandwidth requirements.
accept: a VPN is quick to set up
a VPN is encrypted over the internet

key_points.point: Performance over the internet is best effort; Direct Connect gives a more consistent network experience than internet-based connections.
accept: the internet is not predictable
Direct Connect is steadier

key_points.point: A new dedicated Direct Connect connection can take from several weeks to a few months to install.
accept: Direct Connect takes weeks or months
Direct Connect is not ready this week

key_points.point: With Direct Connect and a VPN to the same VPC, the Direct Connect path is preferred and the VPN is used for failover.
accept: the VPN becomes the backup
Direct Connect wins while it is up

key_points.point: You are charged for Direct Connect port hours even when no data is passing through the port.
accept: Direct Connect has a fixed cost

key_points.point: Hosted connections from a Direct Connect Partner can often be provisioned faster than dedicated connections.
accept: a partner can be faster

must_not_say.error: Direct Connect can be ready in a day or two.
must_not_say.correct: A new dedicated connection can take from several weeks to a few months to install.

must_not_say.error: A VPN gives you the same steady performance as a private line.
must_not_say.correct: Performance over the internet is best effort, and internet congestion and latency can be unpredictable.

must_not_say.error: With both links up, we can split the traffic between Direct Connect and the VPN.
must_not_say.correct: The Direct Connect path is preferred whenever it is established, so the VPN carries traffic for failover.

follow_ups.question: Do we pay for Direct Connect when nothing is sent?
follow_ups.answer: Yes. You are charged for port hours even when no data is passing through the port.

follow_ups.question: Can we get a smaller line than a dedicated connection?
follow_ups.answer: Yes. A Direct Connect Partner provisions a hosted connection on behalf of a customer, starting at 50 Mbps.
